description: Held-out split of the live-database retrieval golden set (task 197): the same format, matching rules and id prefixes as tests/retrieval_golden_live.json, whose description applies here too. It holds about one query in six of each id prefix of the combined set (sorted by id, every 6th starting at the 4th), moved out of the main file on 2026-10-11. Use it to check that a setting tuned on the main file holds on queries the tuning never looked at: while tuning (pool sizes, weights, floors, model swaps), compare and inspect per-query results on the main file only, then score this file once at the end with the same `memhub eval retrieval --golden tests/retrieval_golden_holdout.json --k 5 --json` and `memhub eval compare` procedure and report its totals. Do not tune against its per-query outcomes.
